claims.assertion: Anéeka says flat-Earth narratives confuse people and weaken belief in extraterrestrial life by denying other planets.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the Federation has no obvious direct link.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says the Van Allen belts are not a solid dome; atmospheric strata can reflect waves according to frequency.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She compares this with long-distance ship radio.

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes Earth as an irregular geoid whose uneven surface produces measurable gravity and magnetic anomalies.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She calls it potato-shaped as an analogy.
